description: The soundstage floor: a black-painted expanse ribbed with taped cable runs and pocked with camera marks, hemmed by a horseshoe of studio lamps hanging cold on their grid. A vacant anchor desk waits under a KSAB eyecatch, and the cyclorama behind it can be any skyline in the world, though right now it's none, just seamless grey. The air is hot dust and gaffer tape. A tally light on the lead camera pulses red: the deck upstairs is always listening.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
